## Testing Mode
UPDATE

## Story DD Coverage
- DD6: Loop detects push-induced approval dismissal and does not double-count restarted CI runs as separate poll timeouts

## Description
Extend `_phase_poll` and `_phase_resolve_threads` in `plugins/dso/scripts/merge-to-main-pr.sh` to detect push-induced CI restart and approval dismissal, ensuring the wall-clock window does not double-count.

## Files to Modify
- `plugins/dso/scripts/merge-to-main-pr.sh` (MODIFY)

## Detection Logic
When a code-change ACTION dispatches a `git push origin HEAD`, capture the new HEAD SHA. On the next poll iteration:
1. Query `gh pr view <pr> --json headRefOid,reviewDecision,reviews` and detect:
   - `headRefOid` changed since last iteration -> CI restart was triggered by our push
   - Any review with state `DISMISSED` and `submittedAt` after the push timestamp -> push-induced dismissal
2. When push-induced restart detected:
   - Reset poll wall-clock window for `_phase_poll` (do NOT escalate as timeout)
   - Continue the resolve-threads loop with original `start_ts` (dispatch budget unchanged) — only the per-iteration check-conclusion timeout is reset
3. Emit `INFO: push-induced CI restart detected — resetting poll window` for observability

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Lint passes (exit 0)
  Verify: shellcheck plugins/dso/scripts/merge-to-main-pr.sh
- [ ] T1 RED test_push_induced_dismissal_resets_poll_window now passes (GREEN)
  Verify: bash tests/integration/test-merge-to-main-pr-thread-resolution.sh -k 'push_induced_dismissal'
- [ ] Detection logic uses `headRefOid` field from gh pr view (not text grep)
  Verify: grep -q 'headRefOid' plugins/dso/scripts/merge-to-main-pr.sh
- [ ] Reset emits the structured INFO log line
  Verify: stub assertion in T1 test_push_induced_dismissal_resets_poll_window captures "push-induced CI restart detected"

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context (all 3 failure messages)
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet to opus escalation time: skip opus step, escalate to user immediately
